data.title: Ballet Dancers

thumbnail.alt_text: A diagonal line of leaping ballet dancers recedes from a starkly lit dancer partially visible at bottom left. All are broadly painted against a blue-green ground above them, pale pink below. They have obscured features and are highlighted in yellow and green. A conductor's hands emerge at bottom.

data.medium_display: Oil on plaster, transferred to canvas

data.provenance_text: Painted as part of a series of murals for Pere Ancelin's inn, Villieres-sur-Morin, France, c. 1885–86 until before 1920 [see Murray 1991, Duret 1920]. Christian Tetzen-Lund, Copenhagen. L. C. Hodebert, Paris. Etienne Bignon, Paris. Frederic C. Bartlett (1873–1953); given to the Art Institute of Chicago, 1931.
